en.summary: In her 30 September annual address, President Jennifer Geerlings-Simons presented the 2027 draft budget (revenue SRD 70.1bn, spending SRD 80.9bn, deficit 4% of GDP). She called 2027 a preparation year before offshore oil starts in 2028, with a Local Content Act and a wider tax base (gold, timber, fishing). Public debt is 100.4% of GDP.

La dette publique atteint 100,4 % du PIB.

vi.summary: Trong thông điệp thường niên ngày 30/9, Tổng thống Jennifer Geerlings-Simons trình dự thảo ngân sách 2027 (thu 70,1 tỷ, chi 80,9 tỷ đô la Suriname, thâm hụt 4% GDP).
